verdict.rationale: Gemini in Gmail produces AI insights from the user's own mail: it condenses long threads into bullet-point summaries, offers one-click suggested replies, and proposes meeting times from Google Calendar availability. Hands-on reports confirm these features are in use, including a user who accepts about half of the suggested improvements. One user did see a summary hallucinate a delivery date, which lowers reliability but does not show the capability is absent. Missing for 10: evidence of insights across the whole mailbox rather than per thread, and documented accuracy safeguards.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Summarize: Synthesize long email threads into concise bullet points.
Schedule: Propose meeting times based on your availability in Google Calendar.
suggested replies help you reply in one click, in your voice.
